newsitem.title: GERMANY: German ambassador among Peru hostages.
newsitem.headline: German ambassador among Peru hostages.

text.p: Germany's ambassador to Peru and two other diplomats are among at least 200 hostages held by heavily armed guerrillas at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, the German foreign ministry said on Wednesday.
Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel had set up a crisis centre to deal with the siege, a ministry spokesman said.
Ambassador Heribert Woeckel was being held with around 15 other hostages in one room of the residence, the ministry spokesman said.

Kinkel ordered Germany's ambassador to Bolivia to come to Lima and take over the running of the Lima embassy. A crisis specialist from Bonn would also fly out to the Peruvian capital, the spokesman said.
Cuban-inspired Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) guerrillas began their attack at around 8 p.m. on Tuesday (0100 GMT Wednesday).
They fired a rocket and sprayed gunfire into the building, before scaling walls and entering during the ensuing chaos, eyewitnesses and officials said.
